name: Vance & Alder
oneLiner: A two-principal commercial law firm — plain-English counsel for owner-run businesses: contracts, disputes, property, succession.
paletteSeed: a well-set legal file — oat paper field, ink black, oxblood accents for numerals and rules, stamp-red for the one CONFIDENTIAL mark; the Recent Matters ledger inverts to ink with paper-cream redaction bars
typeDirection: Newsreader variable (one serif family used print-natively: 72-opsz display for the masthead and headlines, 14-opsz for text, real italics for the pull quote and signatures) + Courier Prime (file numbers, marginalia, the redacted ledger — the typewriter register) — all OFL, vendored
motionBudget: reading aids only, every one state-driven: a reading-progress ink rule in the sticky running head (section name swaps as you pass each matter-file section) + plates develop in like photographs (sepia/blur lifting) + index leader-dots draw across + redaction bars swipe in and REFUSE on hover (they never lift — confidentiality as motion) + the CONFIDENTIAL stamp presses in + principals' signatures ink left-to-right; reduced-motion and no-JS both get the complete static page with bars applied
